decisions.reason: This multi-model electric infrared panel line is a flagship of the firm's electrification direction, and after only two years its value is still unresolved while keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.
The halogen heater is a niche single product with weaker strategic weight, but it adds little cost within the infrared range and the evidence does not yet justify abandoning it.
The industrial electric hall heater line sits close to core industrial and logistics customers and fits growing demand for electric heating, so the option remains cheap and promising.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world deployment, and it preserves a high-uncertainty, high-value growth option toward low-carbon heating.
